userDescriptionEn: Build browser 2D games with a reusable development flow: rules, levels, engine and UI. Covers collisions, gravity, rigid bodies, particles, effects, controls, performance and lifecycle, with the playable Parcel starter.
userDescriptionRu: Создавайте браузерные 2D-игры на расширяемой основе: правила, уровни, движок и интерфейс. Столкновения, гравитация, твёрдые тела, частицы, эффекты, управление, производительность и жизненный цикл с примером Parcel.
userDescriptionEs: Crea juegos 2D para navegador con una base reutilizable: reglas, niveles, motor e interfaz. Incluye colisiones, gravedad, cuerpos rígidos, partículas, efectos, controles, rendimiento y ciclo de vida, con el ejemplo Parcel.
agentDescription: Use for building or extending playable browser 2D games with player input, rules, collision or spatial interaction, objectives, and outcomes. Prioritize a reusable structure separating game rules, level data, engine lifecycle, rendering, and UI. Includes the Parcel TypeScript/Phaser/React example and guidance for loop ownership, controls, assets, mobile support, Amazi integration, and verification. Preserve the user's genre and an existing suitable engine; decorative canvas animation alone is not this skill's purpose. Covers advanced collision filtering, sensors, gravity, rigid bodies, constraints, fast-motion detection, particles and effects, with explicit capability choices, lifecycle ownership and a staged playable development flow. Inspect the example’s current structure and import only its standalone application folder contents into Amazi’s allocated application source path.
